description: Create .uvcs-mcp/style.json with branch naming, checkin message, and release conventions. Requires prepare/confirm. Returns a short-lived confirmation token.

baseBranch.description: Base branch for generated branches, for example /main or /main/dev.

branchPrefix.description: Optional safe prefix before branch slugs, for example PROJ-.

overwrite.description: Set true only when replacing an existing .uvcs-mcp/style.json.

preset.description: Style preset. unity is recommended for Unity teams.

versionFile.description: Optional relative version file used by release planning, for example ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt.

name: uvcs_style_init_prepare
